_comment: Addons vendored into addons/ by tools/pull_addons.py. 'ref' is the branch, tag or commit to take; 'main' means always the latest. tools/addons.lock.json records what was actually taken.

addons.name: gut
addons._comment: Test framework only, pinned to a tag. Third-party and never edited here, so push_addons skips it: there is nowhere for a change to go and a tag cannot be checked out as a branch.
